security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Watch and steer every Claude Code session on your machine
bundle.longDescription: scope shows every Claude Code session running on this machine, puts the one waiting on a permission prompt in front of you, and lets you answer it, steer it, start new sessions and resume old ones without leaving the window.
